name: dsh-almost-full-access
description: dsh-Almost Full Access - a permission mode between workspace-write and Full access: every command is first reviewed by deterministic rules plus a subagent, and dangerous commands trigger a minimalist style-A approval panel (Allow / Deny / Remember this session), with session-scoped remember memory and an audit log. Static plugin package for both the desktop (Electron) and web profiles; auto-loads after restart.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/analyze.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check scripts/install.mjs && node --check scripts/patch-lib.mjs && node --check scripts/test.mjs
